name: pnp-sharepoint-skills-assess-change-order
title: Assess Change Order
shortDescription: Reads an accepted construction change order, matches its project by ID, follows the project's dependency chain to find every phase that moves, and records the impact as rows for a person to review.
longDescription: Reads the change order PDF and takes the schedule impact in days and the cost change from the document; it never estimates.

Matches the project by ID (a wrong ID stops the skill with nothing written), reads the project's phase list, and follows the Depends On column: the named phase grows, dependent phases slide whole, everything else is informational.

Prints a receipt with every phase marked Direct, Shifted or Informational and the completion and total before and after, writes one Change row per moved phase, and sets the change order to Assessed with a link to the live dashboard.
